target_customer: Owners and operators of grid-scale batteries and power plants, asset managers and utilities
problem: Battery assets must decide when to buy and sell power at dynamic prices, and rule-based or human-run dispatch leaves value on the table.
business_model: Software for energy asset operators, likely revenue share or subscription (not found)
product_category: AI for energy dispatch and power plant operation

founders.name: Jack O'Grady
founders.background_notes: Per the YC page, 3+ years at Rivian on battery algorithms, data and optimization, started its Battery Data Science Team and pioneered reinforcement learning for fast charging in the R1T and R1S. Education not listed.

competitors.name: Fluence AMS trading platform
competitors.what: AI and forecast based bidding and portfolio optimization for storage, acquired by Fluence
competitors.funding_then: owned by Fluence, a public company

technical_complexity.rationale: Reinforcement learning for market dispatch needs market data, simulation, and market certification; the company later reported CAISO certification in fall 2023 per a profile.

defensibility.rationale: Market certification and trading track record are barriers, but dispatch software competitors existed and models are replicable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action against the company found; the incumbent names come from a third-party profile and a dated Fluence post.

market_need_then: Grid battery capacity was expanding quickly in California and operators needed better dispatch; the founder's launch post frames RL as replacing hard-coded rules. No independent demand data found.

branding.domain_note: Uses atmeto.com; earlier name used keelinglabs.com per an aggregator.

identity.voice_and_tone: Short, direct and confident, with the tagline We build AI that runs power plants

rebrands.why: Not stated; YC page shows Atmeto (f.k.a. Keeling Labs); date unknown

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community about the brand found; the earlier name Keeling Labs was confusable with other Keel and Keeling names.

outcome_analysis: Atmeto, formerly Keeling Labs, applies reinforcement learning to grid battery dispatch and, per a profile, achieved CAISO certification in fall 2023 and began trading in California markets in 2024. The tagline later widened to a world model for power. It is active with YC, Pioneer Fund and Collab Fund listed as backers, but no verified round sizes or revenue figures were found.
notes: Funding unverified: Standout lists about $500K seed, VCBacked and FundedIQ list $500K pre-seed in April 2023, and an AI-generated profile claims $3M seed; no primary source states a round, so none is recorded. The company site lists backers Y Combinator, Pioneer Fund, Collab Fund, Tango.vc and FoundersX without amounts. CAISO certification and trading dates come from a third-party profile. Search and the long description are empty on the world model claim; the YC tagline says world model for power. Cause or date of the rename not found.
